---
title: "Cut trace length"
---

![[Cut Trace]{.ui-label} options.](images/media/data-tools-cut-trace-length.png)

This gives the option to set new record start and finish times (e.g. cut a trace that is $0$–$2\ \mathrm{s}$ long down to $0.5$–$1\ \mathrm{s}$). An offset will always be subtracted to ensure the first record starts at $t = 0$.

The start and finish times refer to the timestamps of the first record, including any initial time offset. For example, if the first record starts at $0.1\ \mathrm{s}$, selecting $0.2$ to $0.4\ \mathrm{s}$ keeps the portion $0.1$ to $0.3\ \mathrm{s}$ after the start of each record. It is recommended to correct for time offset before using [Cut trace length]{.ui-label}.

Clicking [Apply]{.ui-label} will change the record length for every record in the file. Options are provided for cumulatively increasing record times after cutting trace length (e.g. record 1: $0$–$0.5\ \mathrm{s}$, record 2: $0.5$–$1\ \mathrm{s}$) or normalizing time instead (see [Normalize Time](normalize-time.qmd){.ui-label}).
